subject: Claim TM-2026-0115 – Redwell Restoration Report
body:
Dear Redwell Restoration,

I am writing to chase receipt of your report on our claim reference TM-2026-0115 (Ardwell Print Services Limited – escape of water damage, 6 July 2026).

Could you please confirm the date of your next scheduled visit to the premises? This will help us progress the claim efficiently.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Kind regards,
Thornfield Mutual Claims
